name: Ivy (living plants)
notes: Living climbing plants and foliage: ivy on walls, hedges, bushes, briars. Green plants hold water (wetness 0.2), so they need more heat to catch (350 °C) than dead straw, then burn for 45 s. An easy climb (grade ivy), until it burns away. Partial cover: neither transparent nor opaque. Leafy rustle underfoot (+2 dB). Burns away completely (mw-e03.5). Soft surface; blades and arrows sever its vines (cuttable), too weak to anchor a rope arrow. (mw-e03.31)
